launches.title: Prodigy: The Frontier AI Trading Research Lab
launches.tagline: Training the world's best foundation model for quantitative finance
launches.body:
**TL;DR** Prodigy Research is an AI lab that has trained the world's best foundation model for quantitative finance. We’ve already achieved 140% returns in live trading over the course of our YC batch, while major indices like the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq were flat or down.

**Traction**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=109747&key=user_uploads/3203618/c02ef51e-f0e4-43b8-a335-b55e66d5afd2)

Our model beats Claude Fable and GPT-5.6 Sol at financial and quant research tasks. Prodigy's strategies are delta-neutral, and thanks to our rigorous and comprehensive risk controls, we've never had a down week.

<https://youtu.be/wkT96INB3RA>

**Why Now**

Trading firms generated hundreds of billions in profit last year, and this number is growing quickly YoY. Global financial markets now exceed $175 trillion in value across equities, derivatives, and digital assets. Prodigy's agents find new opportunities and alpha in the financial markets faster than any team of human quant researchers.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=109747&key=user_uploads/3203618/31e0abc2-381b-4cdb-8d4f-86498b669b39)

**The Team**

Our founders are two brothers who left seven-figure jobs to build the future of quant trading. We bring together over 16 years of combined experience in quantitative finance, frontier model research, and large-scale AI infrastructure. Michael was a senior researcher at **Google DeepMind**, where he trained SoTA foundation models. He previously worked at **Jane Street**, one of the world’s most successful quantitative trading firms. Yuhua built cutting-edge AI at **Apple** serving **billions of users** across the world.

A new era has arrived in the world of quantitative finance. To learn more, contact [founders@prodigy.markets](mailto:founders@prodigy.markets).
